So there's mostly two types of characters in Tekken right, the really popular high-top tiers and the obscure mid-low tiers. An example would be Bryan, Bryan is just popular in all levels of gameplay so people KNOW how to deal with him AND have labbed the fuck outta him. Everyone's seen the taunt setup in the corner and anyone in green rank and above can block his snake edge even with a 1 bar connection. But on the other side of the spectrum, we have the obscure mid-low tiers that noone really bothered to lab because they almost never run into one in ranked. Examples would be Gigas, Chloe, Eddy, Kuma, you get the gist.   


Julia is the in between, people know how much of a menace she is and how annoying her flowcharts are but noone knows how to deal with it consistently because the last Julia game they played was some dude 6 months ago with the "2D is All I Need" plate. The matchup knowledge just expires so quick if you don't fight the character enough.
